Release: datasette-charts 0.2a1

Minor UI improvements:

  • Collapsing the suggested charts section now leaves the chart visible.
  • Following a link to a chart opens it with the suggestions collapsed for that visit.
  • On table pages the panel now sits below the "4,235 rows where country = CHN" line.
  • The "Data" table under each chart has been replaced by Copy TSV and Copy CSV buttons.
  • Removed the "Chart this data" item from the table, view and query action menus.
  • More space between lines in chart tooltips.
